title: EvidenceRecord
description: Provenance record capturing fetch metadata, content addressing, and cryptographic integrity.

resolved_url.description: The resolved target URL with any credentials sanitized and redacted.

timestamp.description: The UTC timestamp when the content was fetched.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest covering the bytes as received before any normalisation.

backend_name.description: The name of the external backend process that performed the fetch.

backend_version.description: The version of the external backend process.

is_fallback.description: Whether this fetch used a fallback backend path.

backend_args.description: Arguments passed to the backend, with all credentials redacted.

normalisation.description: Metadata for any normalisation performed on the raw bytes.

record_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the canonical record fields for tamper detection.

prev_record_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the preceding record in the append-only ledger chain.

backend_status.description: Health or availability status of the backend (e.g. reachable, unreachable, wrong-version).

missing_backends.description: List of missing or unreachable backend tools encountered before this fetch succeeded.

backend_attempts.description: Attempts made across backends during failover orchestration.
